THIS BAIL APPLICATION HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 10.06.2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:

--------------------------------
 Dated this the 10th day of June 2024  ORDER
This Bail application is filed apprehending arrest in the complaint filed by the wife of the first petitioner alleging commission of the offence under Section 498A of IPC.
The Bail Application was last posted on 23/02/2022.

If the crime is registered only for the offence under Section 498A and the petitioners have so far not been questioned, the Investigating Officer shall proceed in accordance with the directives of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Satender Kumar Antil v. CBI [(2022) 10 SCC 51].
